en: Captain, red alert! Red\nalert! Red alert!!!

I have detected a massive
fluctuation in the fabric of
space-time! If we fail to
take evasive action, the
ship will be engulfed by a
dimensional rift from which
there is no escape!
Then take evasive action,\nCoro! Do it now!
Urk!
It is too late for that!\nPrepare for impact!
Eeeeeeeeek!

What happened? And
what is this place? I don't
remember transporting
down to a planet surface.

Oh no, oh no, oh no, oh no!
Captain, Captain, Captain!
This is no red alert! It's an
anomaly!
Coro, please... Take a\ndeep breath and give me\na status report.
Y-Yes, that would be the\nproper course of action.\nScanning... Scanning...

Well... It appears our
current location is
unknown, as is the
location of our ship.
Communications are
completely out and―
There you are...Earthlings.
Huh!?
Wh-where'd that voice\ncome from?

Filthy Earthlings. You know
nothing of the <font color=yellow>Muah</font>'s
suffering. Did you truly
think you could just waltz
onto this planet to
partake of its splendors?
They were meant to be\nours.
You will spend eternity\ntrapped in this place.

You will finally experience
firsthand the suffering of
the Muah, who yearned to
return to Earth.
The Muah? What are they\neven talking about?

I cannot say. However, I
seem to recall seeing a
record of the Muah
somewhere―
That's enough, <font color=yellow>Jie\nRevorse</font>!
I won't let you drag any\nmore innocent people into\nthis!
Trapping them in this\nplace...
It won't free the Muah―\nNo, make that, it won't\nfree you of your suffering!
So, you people still seek\nto defy me?
Jie Revorse...?

Ah, here it is! This voice
does indeed belong to one
Jie Revorse, dictator of
planet Fargett.
Huh!? So you've heard of\nJie Revorse!?
Oh, forgive me. I am\n<font color=yellow>Roddick Farrence</font>.
And I'm <font color=yellow>Millie Chliette</font>.

We've been battling him
for some time now, but all
I can say is there is
something strange about
this place.

We are most likely in a
special area of space-time
that Jie Revorse created
to trap us and other
Earthlings.
That's probably why you\ngot caught up in this.
The only way to escape is\nto defeat him.

How can this be? We
were just sailing along
minding our own business
when we were suddenly
sucked into this strange
place. I think I am about to
go into CPU overload.

Furthermore, to have to
face an assailant from
200 years ago... I am
surprised I am not already
a heap of wreckage.

Still, if we were to battle
Jie Revorse and live to tell
about it, I would have
something to brag about
to my AI bot pals back on
Earth. Then again...ooh!
Umm, is your robot going\nto be okay? It sounds like\nhe's broken.
Nope, he's always like this.

Anyway, now that we
know what's what, let's go
and put an end to that Jie
Revorse!

Please, you must hear my
concerns! And Evelysse,
you must not be so hasty!
Captain, please say
something.
Let's go defeat Jie\nRevorse!
You told us your names,\nbut who exactly are you?
Oh, no, Coro is broken!
Not you, too, Captain!

We won't get anything
done standing around
wringing our hands. Let's
go get the job done!
Oh, right. We're members\nof the Kratus Defense\nForce.

While we were patrolling
Kratus, we were
enveloped in a strange
light. Next thing we knew,
we found ourselves here.

Yeah, then Jie Revorse,
whom we had already
defeated, suddenly
attacked us. We were in
total shock to say the
least!

(They are without a doubt
the Roakians who saved
Earth along with the
heroic Admiral Kenny.)

What!? I am broken!?
Come to think of it, I have
not been feeling myself
lately, and―

Wait a second! I am
functioning just fine! I am
just as restless and
neurotic as always, and
my face as frightening as
ever!
Like I said, he's always like\nthis.
Well, Captain, are we going\nto go fight Jie Revorse or\nnot?

We'd like to help! After all,
Jie Revorse is an evil man
who has tormented
countless others!
Together, we won't fail to\ntake him down!
<player>, I wanted to thank\nyou and your crew.
We were finally able to\ndefeat Jie Revorse thanks\nto you.

Don't mention it. Besides,
it wasn't like we were
going to stand around
here doing nothing.
I'd say we were just as\nlucky to have met you\ntwo.

It seems this space is
disappearing now that
we've defeated Jie
Revorse.

We should all be returned
to the locations where we
were before we were
brought here.

I'd say goodbye, but I have
a strange feeling we will
meet again. So maybe
"see you later" would be
more appropriate.
Please tell me all about\nyour adventures in space\nthe next time we meet.
Me, too! Me, too! Let's\nenjoy a parfait together\nnext time!
I know a really yummy\nplace! I'll hold you to that\npromise!
Hm? The spatial anomaly,\nit's... Captain, our time\nhere is almost up!
<player>!
Should we meet again, I\nwill be the one helping\nyou.
So please, don't ever\nforget about us!
Goodbye everyone! At\nleast until we meet again!
...Did we make it back?
It would appear so.
Well, that was one of the\nstranger experiences I've\nhad.
You can say that again.\nWhat exactly was that\nstrange space anyway?
Heck if I know.
Still, we met some nice\npeople, so it wasn't a total\nloss.
Agreed!
Well, Captain, let's get\nback on course.
Full speed ahead, Coro!\nFull speed ahead!
